text:
Amelia (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get concrete windows for the API tiering, Console batching UI, and Optimize recommendations? People are asking for dates to plan launches.

Devon (Eng): short answer: API tiering beta ~3w, Console batching UI targeting end of Q2, Optimize recommendations alpha by end of month. caveats below.

Cecilia (PM Lead): to be explicit — those are knobs in order of priority: 1) API tiering (billing + quotas) 2) Console batching UI (observability + controls) 3) Optimize recommendations (analysis engine + suggestions). each depends on infra pieces.

Marta (Ops): for Dedicated/Dedicated+ customers we need an SLA addendum before GA. ops will need ~2 weeks after engineering signoff to run certification tests.

Devon (Eng): caveats: API tiering requires a short migration plan for existing customers (backwards-compatible default). batching UI relies on new batching metrics from runtime v1.9 (rolling next week). Optimize needs additional eval hooks — we can ship suggestions in read-only mode first.

Kai (DevEx): I can draft a one-pager + migration checklist. Anyone want to pair on the default policy text? I'll drop a PR to docs next Tuesday.

Amelia (Product): useful — can someone confirm whether "end of Q2" means the 6/30 cutoff (hard) or 'by mid-July' (soft)? We need marketing and sales to know.

Devon (Eng): aiming for June 28th for internal launch (canary -> broaden next week). external GA still depends on certify tests but target June 30th.

Cecilia (PM Lead): accepted wording for comms: "Console batching UI: internal canary late June; public rollout early July pending certification."

Raj (CEO): agree with that framing. also emphasize a clear rollback path in comms for customers using heavy batching. customers should be able to opt-out quickly. :thumbsup:

Marta (Ops): noted. ops will prepare an opt-out guide and patch in the Console docs. ETA for docs sync: July 5.

Devon (Eng): small code snippet for the API tiering beta toggle we'll use in the admin panel:
```
PATCH /admin/v1/tenant/tiers
{ "tier": "pro", "quota": { "tokens_per_minute": 60000 } }
```
This will be behind a feature flag; no public surface change for standard keys.

Amelia (Product): nice. product action items: (A) Publish timeline + migration checklist (owner: Kai) (B) Prepare comms draft for customers w/ high-throughput (owner: Raj & Cecilia) (C) Confirm SLA language (owner: Marta).

Kai (DevEx): I'll take (A) and start the PR. linking infra ticket when it's up.

Cecilia (PM Lead): I'll draft comms with Raj. target internal review by June 21.

Marta (Ops): SLA draft will be ready June 25 for legal/finance review.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime v1.9 -> 6 nodes in us-west on 2024-06-20T18:00:00Z.

Amelia (Product): thanks everyone — can we reconvene in #product-next-week to confirm final wording before publishing? I'll pin this thread. :calendar:
